description: Données théoriques du réseau de Transport à la Demande AlloTIC - Communauté d'Agglomération de la Région de Compiègne et de la Basse Automne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Oise Mobilité - Syndicat mixte des transports collectifs de l'Oise. Within the framework of the Integrated System of Mobility Services in Oise (SISMO) implemented by the Combined Union of Collective Transport of Oise, the Community of Aglomeration of the Region of Compiègne and Lower Autumn benefits from the Oise Mobility route calculator and temp-real information on board its vehicles and at the stop points. Coverage: Oise Mobilité - Syndicat mixte des transports collectifs de l'Oise. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical data of the transport network on demand AlloTIC – Community of agglomeration of the Region of Compiègne and " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Oise Mobilité - Syndicat mixte des transports collectifs de l'Oise. Its keywords include gtfs-rt, compiegne, transport-a-la-demande, gtfs, ligne-reguliere, bus. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS, NETEX. The listing shows 2024-01-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
